demos.name: Poppy Agent Tester
demos.description: Play the personal agent from the Personal Agent Protocol (Poppy, Draft 0.3): read a Company's poppy.json, sign in to a real PingFederate with a URL as the client id and PKCE, then call the Company API with a signed Poppy-Session. Every request and token is shown raw.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 5450). Live local run needs a PingFederate with a CIMD policy for the agent URL (see docs/setup.md) and a Company that serves poppy.json. Docker: HOST_PORT=5450 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). The hosted Mock card is the SE build (MODE=mock): it explains and shows an example run with invented values, and reaches nothing. The real mockUrl is set only in the shelf's local file, never in this repo (placeholder host here).
